title: In silico design and In Vitro validation of WK15: a promising antimicrobial peptide for aquaculture applications.
authors: Lohumi, Yamini; Bhat, Raja Aadil Hussain; Bisht, Ila; Pande, Amit
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计抗菌肽WK15并验证其抗菌活性，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心是抗菌肽-膜/蛋白互作而非TF-DNA转录结合，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度不足，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides serve as an innate defence mechanism against various pathogens. They are being explored as potential alternatives to antibiotics and could play an important role in addressing antimicrobial resistance in aquaculture. In this study, a novel 15-mer antimicrobial peptide, WK15, was rationally designed from the alpha-subunit of rainbow trout haemoglobin. The peptide is amphipathic, exhibits strong membrane interactions, and has a net charge of + 5. Molecular docking showed that WK15 binds strongly to aerolysin, a virulence protein of Aeromonas sobria. Its antimicrobial activity was tested against a range of bacterial pathogens, including Staphylococcus epidermidis, Lactococcus garvieae, Staphylococcus aureus, Edwardsiella tarda, Aeromonas sobria, Yersinia ruckeri, and Aeromonas hydrophila. The peptide exhibited broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, with minimum inhibitory concentration values ranging from 22.6 microM to 500 microM and minimum bactericidal concentration values from 45.2 microM to 700 microM. Additionally, WK15 remained stable and effective at higher temperatures and under elevated salt and serum levels. DNA-binding assays confirmed its concentration-dependent interaction with bacterial DNA in vitro, suggesting that DNA binding may represent a potential secondary mechanism. The peptide demonstrated negligible cytotoxicity toward the Epithelioma Papulosum Cyprini cell line and low haemolytic activity against fish erythrocytes, indicating favourable biocompatibility and reduced host-cell toxicity. Scanning electron microscopy analysis of S. aureus treated with WK15 revealed significant morphological alterations consistent with membrane-targeting activity. Collectively, these findings highlight that WK15 is a promising candidate with high stability and negligible host toxicity, underscoring its potential as an alternative to conventional antibiotics in aquaculture.
abstract_zh: 抗菌肽作为针对多种病原体的先天防御机制发挥作用。它们正被探索作为抗生素的潜在替代品，并可能在解决水产养殖中的抗菌素耐药性方面发挥重要作用。在本研究中，一种新型15-mer抗菌肽WK15，是从虹鳟鱼血红蛋白的α亚基合理设计而来。该肽具有两亲性，表现出强烈的膜相互作用，净电荷为+5。分子对接 (molecular docking) 显示，WK15与气单胞菌溶素（Aeromonas sobria的一种毒力蛋白）紧密结合。其抗菌活性针对一系列细菌病原体进行了测试，包括表皮葡萄球菌 (Staphylococcus epidermidis)、格氏乳球菌 (Lactococcus garvieae)、金黄色葡萄球菌 (Staphylococcus aureus)、迟缓爱德华氏菌 (Edwardsiella tarda)、温和气单胞菌 (Aeromonas sobria)、鲁氏耶尔森菌 (Yersinia ruckeri) 和嗜水气单胞菌 (Aeromonas hydrophila)。该肽表现出广谱抗菌活性，最低抑菌浓度 (minimum inhibitory concentration) 值范围为22.6微摩尔至500微摩尔，最低杀菌浓度 (minimum bactericidal concentration) 值范围为45.2微摩尔至700微摩尔。此外，WK15在较高温度以及升高的盐和血清水平下仍保持稳定和有效。DNA结合实验证实了其在体外与细菌DNA的浓度依赖性相互作用，表明DNA结合可能代表一种潜在的次级机制。该肽对鲤鱼上皮乳头瘤细胞系 (Epithelioma Papulosum Cyprini cell line) 表现出可忽略的细胞毒性，并对鱼红细胞具有低溶血活性，表明其具有良好的生物相容性和降低的宿主细胞毒性。对经WK15处理的金黄色葡萄球菌进行的扫描电子显微镜 (scanning electron microscopy) 分析显示，其形态发生显著改变，与膜靶向活性一致。总体而言，这些发现强调WK15是一个有前景的候选分子，具有高稳定性和可忽略的宿主毒性，突显其作为水产养殖中传统抗生素替代品的潜力。
